status_model_note: STATUS REDESIGN (schema_version 2): causal reconstructability and experiment readiness are now SEPARATE. Being reconstructable from immutable rows (CAUSAL_CONTRACT_PROVEN) does NOT make a target an experiment entrant. EXPERIMENT_ELIGIBLE is granted ONLY when ALL experiment-readiness gates pass (see per-target experiment_readiness block). Zero targets are EXPERIMENT_ELIGIBLE in this Stage 1 foundation, by truthful classification.
horizon_notes: PRIMARY_DECISION_HORIZONS in ml_horizon.py:31; 'c' = one canonical 1-minute candle. Threshold JSON also lists 3c/8c/13c but the DB snapshots schema materializes NO outcome column for them (O-10: 3c/8c/13c diagnostic-only, outside authoritative replay parity).

horizon_span_semantics.defect_corrected: Prior descriptions said the label measures 'the move over N minutes'. That is FALSE for the bar-anchored contract. N is the count of forward whole-minute candles, not the elapsed minutes from anchor_close to forward_close.
horizon_span_semantics.anchor_rule: anchor bar = last completed price_bars_1m row with bar_end_ts_utc <= T; anchor_close is observed at anchor_bar_start + 60s.
horizon_span_semantics.forward_rule: forward_bar_start = floor((T + N*60)/60)*60; forward_close is observed at forward_bar_start + 60s.
horizon_span_semantics.derivation: For an anchor-aligned observation the anchor_close→forward_close elapsed span is (N+1) whole minutes: forward_close completes at anchor_bar_start + (N+2)*60 while anchor_close is at anchor_bar_start + 60, so elapsed = (N+1)*60s. Nominal '60c' therefore realizes a 61-minute span; '1c' realizes 2 minutes.
horizon_span_semantics.purge_embargo_rule: Any overlap purge/embargo MUST use the TRUE max realized span per horizon, i.e. (N+1) minutes, NOT N. A multi-horizon model spanning up to 60c must purge/embargo at least 61 minutes.
horizon_span_semantics.stage2_binding: The Stage 2 contract MUST treat the nominal 60c target as a span of at least 61 minutes for purge, embargo, and horizon-alignment (see stage2_experiment_contract_v1.json:label_span_minutes).

status_definitions.CANDIDATE: proposed outcome; NOT yet proven reconstructable from immutable source rows by an in-repo causal-contract test (either unimplemented, research-scratch only, or dependent on unpinned inputs).
status_definitions.CAUSAL_CONTRACT_PROVEN: implemented AND reconstructable from immutable source rows AND its causal contract is proven by tests/test_stage1_causal_label_contract.py. This is a CAUSALITY statement ONLY. It does NOT assert data-quality sufficiency, coverage, fitted thresholds, provenance control, overlap control, or experiment readiness. A CAUSAL_CONTRACT_PROVEN target is NOT a Stage 2 entrant.
status_definitions.DATA_QUALITY_PROVEN: CAUSAL_CONTRACT_PROVEN AND all data-quality gates pass (coverage, fitted thresholds where applicable, synthetic-provenance control, class-balance governance) but at least one remaining experiment-readiness gate (overlap/purge-embargo, cost binding, barrier-spec) is not yet satisfied. Still NOT a Stage 2 entrant.
status_definitions.EXPERIMENT_ELIGIBLE: CAUSAL_CONTRACT_PROVEN AND every applicable experiment-readiness gate passes (see experiment_readiness.gates). ONLY EXPERIMENT_ELIGIBLE targets may be selected by the Stage 2 eligibility query. This is an eligibility statement, NOT an approval or a predictive-validity claim.
status_definitions.LEGACY_BASELINE_ONLY: the currently-deployed production label, faithfully reconstructed. Usable in Stage 2 ONLY as a baseline to beat, NEVER as an institutional entrant judged on its own merit. It is causally reconstructable but carries known data-quality defects (placeholder thresholds, flat-majority degeneracy, uncontrolled provenance/overlap). Mutually exclusive with EXPERIMENT_ELIGIBLE.
status_definitions.INVALID: defined but dead/invalidated or non-reconstructable; excluded from experiments.
status_definitions.PRODUCTION_APPROVED: FORBIDDEN in Stage 1 — no entry may carry this status.

experiment_readiness_gate_definitions.coverage_sufficient: labeled rows cover enough of the governed population that a Stage 2 comparison is not dominated by missingness (movement-family ~9.1% coverage FAILS this).
experiment_readiness_gate_definitions.thresholds_fitted: any dead-band / movement threshold is fitted by a declared, reproducible procedure (percentile-fit) rather than a placeholder or ATR-fallback. applicable=false for pure regression targets.
experiment_readiness_gate_definitions.synthetic_provenance_flagged: synthetic-repaired bars participating in the label are distinguished by a provenance flag so Stage 2 can stratify/exclude them.
experiment_readiness_gate_definitions.class_balance_governed: class balance is measured and governed (not silently flat-majority-degenerate).
experiment_readiness_gate_definitions.overlap_purge_embargo_defined: an overlap purge/embargo policy is DEFINED for the true (N+1)-minute span, not left UNSPECIFIED.
experiment_readiness_gate_definitions.cost_binding: economic targets bind a declared, versioned, non-NONE cost model. applicable=false for non-economic targets.
experiment_readiness_gate_definitions.barrier_spec_fitted: path/barrier targets bind a fitted, preregistered barrier spec. applicable=false for non-barrier targets.
experiment_readiness_gate_definitions.eligibility_rule: experiment_readiness.eligible == (causal_contract_proven AND every applicable gate .ok). promotion_status EXPERIMENT_ELIGIBLE requires eligible==true; LEGACY_BASELINE_ONLY requires eligible==false.

targets.economic_meaning: sign of the raw close-to-close move to the Nth forward candle (realized span N+1 minutes), with a small dead-band; NOT cost-aware, NOT tradeability

targets.target_timestamp: forward bar start floor((T+N*60)/60)*60, closes +60s (Nth forward candle, realized span N+1 minutes)

targets.session_policy: labeler applies NO session filter (labels every snapshot in a 14-day window); RTH enters only in threshold SELECTION and downstream cohorts. This is the DEPLOYED production behavior — reconstructed faithfully, NOT institutionally governed for session crossover.
targets.label_completion_rule: written only when forward bar fully complete (tz >= b_start+60); else NULL; outcome_filled=1 iff all 4 horizons non-null

targets.missing_data_policy: forward_close absent -> horizon NULL; interior gaps repaired by synthetic_interior_grid_repair_v1 + edge_carry + anchor_coverage_pad
targets.synthetic_data_policy: synthetic-repaired bars participate; NOT distinguished in the label; a synthetic/real provenance flag is a Stage 1 gap
